title: Lope de Soria (Genoa) to Charles de Lannoy, viceroy of Naples, 7 March 1527, Biblioteca Estense, Autografoteca Campori, Lettera L, Lope de Soria, cc. 9-12 (catalogue 1562)

documents.shelfmark: Modena, Biblioteca Estense Universitaria, Autografoteca Campori, Lettera L, Lope de Soria, cc. 9-12
documents.route: Genoa -> Charles de Lannoy, viceroy of Naples

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the leaves and no clear copy filed with them; none found in DECODE, CSP Spain III.2 or Villa's Memorias (6 Nov 2026).

transcription.source: Estense IIIF images (Lodovico Media Library), full-size leaves stitched from 1500-px tiles; line crops at full resolution
transcription.notes: Transcribed by two Claude Opus 5.5 sub-agents (9r/9v/11r and 10r/10v) with a shared sign legend (transcription/LEGEND.md); two sign splits made during the reading (closed 4 = o vs open 4s = s; agent A's footed z = u vs agent B's crossed z = d). The 2494 tokens include 53 frame marks (11, g#, -o-, ny). No human has checked the transcription.

system.summary: homophonic letter signs (about 50 types, a few polyvalent) plus a code of three-letter Latin groups (dri que, leb de, den no, lab las, fip galeras, pre Su Magestad) for words and syllables, with frame marks 11, g#, -o-.
system.sibling_key: Lannoy's own cipher with Charles V (Kolosova 2017, Ko.5) shares several letter-sign shapes but not their values (11 is a there, a frame mark here) nor the code; Soria's keys A and B (targets/soria1523) do not fit. Not used.
system.notes: Code groups stand for words and also syllables (leb de in se de-clare, lue es in nu-es-tras, den no in Ge-no-ua), as in Soria's key B. Polyvalent signs to g/a, # e/q, ff i/e, as P = a/g in his key A. Frame marks 11, g#, -o- open and close each cipher run; g# is also ha inside the text.

prior_solution.where: none found: DECODE, Tomokiyo, Kolosova 2017, Galende Diaz (as summarised by Tomokiyo), CSP Spain III.2, Villa 1875 (6 Nov 2026)

conditions.human_role: nothing beyond the task (the catalogue entry's contributor brief, pasted by Daniel Bourdeau)
tools: joint sign/code-group simulated annealing (solve/wsa5.c from targets/cardona1517, driver solve/ann.py)
5-gram character model of 1520s chancery Spanish (solve/build_lm.py: Villa's Memorias, Danvila MHE 37, Soria's own readings)
key-word-in-context reading of the code groups (solve/kwic.py)

solution.what: IIIF manifest of the Estense record fetched; the server refuses regions over ~1600 px, so the 3170 x 4480 leaves were stitched from 1500-px tiles. Outcome: 8 sides; cipher on 9r (two short runs), 9v, 10r, 10v and 11r (the vetting note had seen 10r and 11r only).
Soria's keys A and B (targets/soria1523, soria1527) compared by code-group inventory. Outcome: failed: different code groups (key B initials z y x t s p; key A cap, lod, luc ...).

Kolosova 2017 thesis (Lannoy's Ko.5 key, Soria's Ko.6), Tomokiyo spanish2.htm (Galende Diaz 1992 summary), BRAH 9/15 key book (R9815-R9832), DECODE dumps, CSP Spain III.2 Feb-Apr 1527, Villa's Memorias index. Outcome: no key and no copy of this letter; Lannoy's Ko.5 letter table shares several signs (11, 4, 3, 7, angle, ff, g#, #, +) but not the code.

Matched control: 450 words of Danvila MHE 38 enciphered with 40 homophonic signs and 70 code groups (1408 tokens), 16 runs of wsa5 at 2M iterations. Outcome: 100% of sign tokens recovered in the top runs; 41-60% of code-group tokens.
Sign legend written; two sub-agents transcribed 9r/9v/11r and 10r/10v from full-resolution line crops (2494 tokens).
Noisy matched control: Danvila MHE 38, 1001 tokens, 43 signs, 110 code groups, 5% misread signs. Outcome: 93-95% of sign tokens in the top runs.
wsa5 on the first 687 transcribed tokens (16 runs x 2M): top 3 runs agree on 96-99% of sign tokens; output reads as Spanish (platicas, parcialidades, republica, el papa).
Two 4-like signs split (closed 4 = o, open 4 = s) from c-o-s-a and o-d-i-o-s-a; agents told to revise.
wsa5 on the full transcription (2494 tokens, 22 runs x 6M), after fixing a parser bug that dropped runs beginning with the # sign. Outcome: top 4 runs agree on 100% of sign tokens.
Code groups valued by context and the code's syllable use (dri que, leb de, den no, lue es, ral con, fip galeras, pre Su Magestad ...); frame marks 11, g#, -o- identified (9r 'por via de Ferrara').
Polyvalent signs to g/a, # e/q, ff i/e read by context after checking 10r L07/L25/L29 in the images; agent A's footed z (= u) split from agent B's crossed z (= d).
Reading aligned to the decode token by token (solve/measure.py): 2332 of 2441 counted cipher tokens read (95.5%); English translation made (reading_en.md).

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 2325 tokens, 76 types, es-golden-age order 4: reading -1.917 per letter; random keys -4.566 (z 7.0); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -2.774 (mean -2.785, z 79.4); annealer on the real text -1.942. Verdict: pass.

The five other Soria records in the Estense (Lettera L cc. 1-8, plus Ferrante Gonzaga's draft to Soria, sfasc. II cc. 10-13) opened from the library's own author search and viewed as 1000-px previews: Soria to Gonzaga 7 Jun 1534 and 31 Mar 1539 (Venice), 6 Apr 1541 (Milan), to Giovanni Mahona 30 Jul 1541 (Milan), and Gonzaga to Soria 10 Apr 1539. Outcome: no cipher on any leaf; the letters and their postscripts are in clear Italian and Spanish, so there is no sibling of the 1527 key there.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -1.889; polyphony 0.008; 116 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -1.942

outcome.method_basis: letter signs recovered by joint annealing on a 1520s Spanish model with no crib or key (top runs agree on 100% of sign tokens); code groups valued from the decoded context.
outcome.fraction_read_source: solve/measure.py: reading_aligned.txt aligned to the decode of solve/tokens.txt; cipher tokens, frame marks not counted; doubtful [?] words, unvalued groups and signs unread

texts.label: Soria to Lannoy, Genoa, 7 March 1527
texts.summary: Soria reports that the Genoese commune and its duke, pressed by the French fleet at Savona, will arm galleys if Charles V pays half, and asks Lannoy to send the six imperial galleys at Naples to join the nine at Genoa; a few citizens are talking with the Pope of neutrality, and the League's draft treaty would leave Savona and the riviera to France. Written eight weeks before the Sack of Rome, while Lannoy was negotiating the truce with Clement VII.

reading_review.note: Sentences build through all five cipher stretches; holes are single code groups (names) and a few blotted signs.

gaps.item: code groups lax pax, zaz, giq, xup, fub, gas, lex, tri, tmi, lir, rez, riz, bel, ten (each once or twice; names, places, rare words)
9v L25 blotted sign under ^3 and 9v L34 water-washed last line
doubtful words 9v L02, L08, L12-13, 10r L12, 10v L02, 11r L07-08
